adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a `raw_html` cook path where `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` (app/models/post.rb), and embedded rendering outputs it with `raw post.cooked` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` and stores `contents` derived from external sources (RSS via Jobs::PollFeed and remote HTML via TopicEmbed.import_remote using ruby-readability/open-uri) without any explicit sanitization in this diff. Thus externally-controlled HTML can be persisted and rendered unsanitized in the embed view, enabling stored XSS if the imported content includes scripts/event-handler attributes.
